'''Clan Rodarch''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clan in existence during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Members of the Rodarch clan were known for keeping [[Asharl panther/Legends|asharl panthers]], training them to fight in battle alongside them. The clan's [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] took pride in the fearless, ever-aware reputation of the asharl [[panther]]s, and over [[Time/Legends|time]], Clan Rodarch adopted the asharl panther as its mascot, painting their [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|armor]] in a manner designed to emulate the [[Feline/Legends|creature's]] pelts.<ref name="Asharl">{{TORcite|type=codex|Asharl Panther}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Clan Rodarch was first introduced to ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', created by [[BioWare]].<ref name="Asharl" />
